intro: Pyrewood Ambush is a critical strike coordinated by the Deathstalkers inside the cursed town of Pyrewood Village. By assassinating the local human council, the Forsaken hope to break Archmage Arugal's grip on the cursed inhabitants and weaken his fortress looming above.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You got here just in the nick of time, friend!

The Pyrewood Council will be returning any moment. Arugal has other matters to tend to in the keep. He uses the Council as mere puppets to keep the mindless minions of Pyrewood under his control. But I believe that without the guidance of the Pyrewood Council, the sons of Arugal will turn against their master.
I cannot handle them all by myself. I need you to help me. Together we can lay waste to the Council for Lady Sylvanas.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You fought like a true disciple of the Dark Lady, friend. With the council dead, perhaps we can gain control of this town once and for all and drive Arugal from Shadowfang Keep. I salute you!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
